name: Cursed Ground lengthens Sanguine Rupture, whose bleed is already native (#2041)
contract: Cursed Ground 561195 has two effects. Effect 0 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 10 = SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, BasePoints 1999 + DieSides 1 = +2000 ms, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 2147483648) - family-26 word 2 bit 31, which is exactly Sanguine Rupture 572907's SpellFamilyFlags. 572907's own CastingTimeIndex 1 is SpellCastTimes.dbc row 1 = 0 ms, so the talent turns an instant cast into a 2000 ms cast; Player::ApplySpellMod carries an explicit carve-out for a positive flat SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME on a zero base, and 572907 is DmgClass 1, so the result is scaled by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED, which is 1.0 on an ungeared fixture. This is the only clause the talent owns. Effect 1 is aura 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on Cursed Ground 561205 with ProcFlags 0 on the record and no spell_proc row anywhere in data/sql, so it can never fire, and 561205 is itself an aura 4 SPELL_AURA_DUMMY with no handler and no spell_script_names row - a tooltip carrier. The bleed the tooltip names is delivered natively with no talent at all: 572907 effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL (64) on Cursed Ground 561304 with TargetA 22 = TARGET_SRC_CASTER and TargetB 15 = TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY at radius index 14 = 8.0 yd - the same target list as its damage effect 0 - and 561304 effect 0 is another SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL on Cursed Ground 561303 at TargetA 6 = TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY. So every non-missed enemy within 8 yd receives 561303, whatever the target count. 561303 is aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, Amplitude 500, DurationIndex 39 = SpellDuration.dbc 2000 ms (4 ticks), Mechanic 15 Bleed, StackAmount 0 so it is not stackable. The tooltip's 'when you strike at least 5 enemies' gate exists in no Spell.dbc field, no spell_proc, spell_linked_spell, spell_custom_attr or spell_script_names row and no core code, so this scenario deliberately asserts no such gate. Six dummies are spawned at 2-7 yd, all inside the 8.0 yd radius, so one cast strikes them all. No proc chance is involved: every step of the chain is a deterministic trigger effect.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Baseline: without the talent Sanguine Rupture is instant (SpellCastTimes.dbc row 1 = 0 ms)
Native: the shipped chain bleeds the target with no talent (572907 -> 561304 -> 561303)
and every enemy inside the 8.0 yd radius, not only the spell's target
561303 has StackAmount 0, so it carries exactly one stack
and it never runs longer than SpellDuration.dbc row 39 = 2000 ms
Wait past the 2000 ms bleed window
The bleed has expired, so the next cast measures a fresh application
DISCRIMINATING: the talent's only clause - Sanguine Rupture now takes 2000 ms to cast
With the talent the same native bleed lands, unchanged
and it is still a single stack - the talent must not apply 561303 a second time
